cases.exposure_context_quote: A 29-year-old female presented in a local hospital emergency with an alleged history of ingestion of gramashru (Paraquat dichloride 24%).
cases.agent_quote: alleged history of ingestion of gramashru (Paraquat dichloride 24%)
cases.circumstance: intentional ingestion suspected; she was a known case of schizophrenia on antipsychotics for 6 years (not explicitly stated as intentional)

symptoms.quote: Renal function test showed acute kidney injury (AKI) and electrolyte imbalance.
Liver function test showed raised total bilirubin level and transaminitis.

symptoms.finding: pulmonary fibrosis with ARDS on HRCT
symptoms.quote: High-resolution computed tomography (HRCT) chest was done which was suggestive of pulmonary fibrosis with acute respiratory distress syndrome.
Mucosal lesions were present on the mouth and tongue.

symptoms.finding: hypoxaemia at referral (SpO2 88% on room air)
symptoms.quote: Her vitals at the time of presentation were BP-110/70 mmHg, PR- 105/min, RR-26/min, Temp-Afebrile, Spo2- 88% on room air.

cases.time_to_care: presented to local hospital on day of ingestion; referred to tertiary hospital on day 4

labs.name: Hb
labs.quote: Laboratory investigation revealed Hb–10.9 mg/dl, TLC-9.63 103/mm3, low platelet count 100 × 103/mm3.

treatment.name: Fuller's earth decontamination
treatment.quote: Immediately, Fuller's earth was used to minimize adsorption.

treatment.name: hemodialysis (local hospital, day of ingestion)
treatment.quote: One session of hemodialysis was done at a local hospital on the day of ingestion of poison.

treatment.name: therapeutic plasma exchange, 1.5 plasma volumes with FFP
treatment.quote: One and a half plasma volume exchange was done with 100% replacement with FFP on the Spectra Optia apheresis system

treatment.name: IV antibiotics, steroids, supportive care; intubation and vasopressors
treatment.quote: The patient appeared sick, was intubated, and put on vasopressor support.

cases.icu_admission: UNVERIFIED (ICU not explicitly stated; intubated and on vasopressor support)
cases.outcome: initial improvement after TPE then clinical worsening; death not explicitly stated
